@Gabriel Harp @Ania Safko @Stephen Thompson – The proposal here is we show a toast with a link that allows the user to jump to the window where the tab was moved if a user is moving an inactive tab into a collapsed group in another window.

If a user is moving a non-active tab into an expanded tab group in another window, we jump to the window that the tab was moved to.

In comparison, in Chrome, regardless of the state of the tab and the state of the tab group, it always jumps to the window where the tab was moved and becomes the active tab.

Edge – Regardless of the state of the tab and the state of the tab group, it always jumps to the window where the tab was moved to. The difference is that if the tab group is collapsed in the other window, when you move an inactive tab, it jumps to that window where the tab was moved but the group doesn't expand (which I think also feels odd).
